claims.statement: Game data from DofusDB is read-only in the panel and refreshed by a script, and Torre picks it through relationship fields.
The DofusDB client pages collections in pages of 50 until the reported total or an empty page, and fetches records by ID deduplicated in chunks of 40 using id[$in][] filters.

The DofusDB client waits 50 ms between requests, sends the User-Agent ta-web/datos-del-juego, throws a Spanish error naming the status and URL on a non-2xx answer, and accepts injected fetch and sleep so tests never reach the network.

fetchQuestData loads every DofusDB quest and then fetches only the NPCs and map positions referenced by the quests' start positions and only the items and monsters named in their computed rewards and needs.

mapQuest names a quest in Spanish, falling back to French and then to 'Misión <id>', keeps the raw startCriterion, and builds start positions with NPC names and map coordinates, leaving nulls when a lookup is missing instead of failing.

Quest prerequisites are only the Qf=<id> terms joined by & in startCriterion; a level containing | is treated as alternatives and contributes none, other terms such as Qa= are ignored, and the result is deduplicated and excludes the quest itself.

DofusDB's need.quests is not used for prerequisites because it lists every quest mentioned in the criterion: quest 275 lists 272, 273 and 274 for (Qf=272|Qf=273|Qf=274) and gets no prerequisites, and quest 879 lists 871 and 878 for Qf=871&Qa=878 and gets only 871.

refreshQuests writes quests through the local API with overrideAccess true in two passes: first creating or updating quest fields by dofusId only when they differ, then linking prerequisites by Payload ID and skipping and counting missing ones.

A refresh with unchanged data writes nothing, refreshedAt is set only on rows created or changed in that run, nothing is ever deleted, and the function returns created, updated and unchanged counts for quests, items and monsters plus missing prerequisite, item and monster counts.

pnpm data:quests runs scripts/refresh-quests.ts with payload run; the script starts Payload with getPayload, writes to the DATABASE_URL database or the pnpm db:dev one when it is empty, prints counts, and exits with code 1 on failure because payload run otherwise exits 0.
A full refresh downloads about 2,000 quests plus about 2,800 items and 1,000 monsters from DofusDB in about a minute, and a rerun changes only what DofusDB changed without deleting rows.
Payload schema push runs only under next dev, so other processes rely on applied migrations.
Agent access rules grant full access to dev and read access to prod; prod writes, including database changes, go through release.yml or need Daniel's explicit yes for that one action.
Game data from DofusDB is refreshed on demand after an Ankama patch.
Nothing loads from DofusDB or Ankama at runtime; item and monster icons are stored only as DofusDB image IDs.
mapItem and mapMonster name rows in Spanish with a French fallback and then 'Objeto <id>' or 'Monstruo <id>', keep an item's level, typeId and iconId, and store a monster's gfxId as iconId.

questRewards computes rewards for a level-200 character from the last rewards entry of each step, using fixe(L) = L(100+2L)^2/20 x duration x experienceRatio, XP = fixe(200) when the optimal level is at least 200 and otherwise 0.3 fixe(opt) + 0.7 fixe(min(200, 1.5 opt)), and kamas = (opt^2 + 20 opt - 20) x kamasRatio x duration.
Reward XP and kamas are floored per step before summing, so quest 241 yields 5,679,336 XP rather than the 5,679,337 a single final floor would give.
Quest 1977 yields 24,316 XP and 552 kamas, matching Torre's guide and dofusdb.fr.
Reward items are summed by item across steps, and emote, spell, title and job reward IDs are collected without duplicates as plain DofusDB IDs.

questNeeds takes delivered items from BringItemToNpc objectives, monsters from FightMonster, MultiFightMonster, FightMonstersOnMap and BringSoulToNpc objectives, sets walksMaps for DiscoverMap and DiscoverSubArea objectives, and ignores FreeForm, GoToNpc, CraftItem and other objectives.

Because DofusDB's need.items summary already includes delivered items, questNeeds keeps the larger of the need.items and delivered quantities instead of their sum, so quest 245 needs 2 of item 8993, not 3.
Torre's guide 'Necesitarás' text stays in the guide summary, filled by the import, while the quests' computed needs come from DofusDB need.items and step objectives.

Before the quests, refreshQuests creates or updates items and then monsters by dofusId only when they change, and resolves reward and need references to their Payload IDs, dropping and counting references with no stored row.
